exactClaim: Proves the sharp $C\sqrt\lambda$ upper bound for nodal length on every fixed smooth closed surface, completing Yau's conjecture there. The upper bound fails for fixed smooth metrics in dimensions three and four, including metrics on S3 arbitrarily close to round. In dimension five, nodal measure can grow faster than $\lambda^{1/2+\varepsilon_0}$ for some fixed $\varepsilon_0\gt 0$, ruling out even arbitrarily small power losses.
scope: A definition-led reading guide; the exact mathematical claim is preserved separately. This is not a proof assessment.
